We studied the effect of longitudinal metabolites' trajectories on instantaneous hazard

```{r}
#> Prepare name map dictionary
name_map <- c(
  "Tryptophan" = "Tryptophan",
  "Nicotinamide" = "Nicotinamide",
  "X5.HIAA" = "5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid",
  "X5.HydroxyTryptamine" = "5-Hydroxytryptamine",
  "Kynurenine" = "Kynurenine",
  "AntranilicAcid" = "Anthranilic acid",
  "X5.HydroxyTryptophol" = "5-hydroxytryptophol",
  "Alanine" = "Alanine",
  "X3.IndoleaceticAcid" = "Indole-3-acetic acid",
  "KynurenicAcid" = "Kynurenic acid"
)
```

```{r HIV_negative_TBM}
alpha.post <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(results_multi_hivneg$mcmc$alphas, as.matrix)
)
dim(alpha.post) # 20k by 10 mets
colnames(alpha.post) <- model.metname
alpha.table <- data.frame(
  metabolite = model.metname,
  median = apply(alpha.post, 2, median),
  sd = apply(alpha.post, 2, sd),
  cri_low = apply(alpha.post, 2, quantile, 0.025),
  cri_upp = apply(alpha.post, 2, quantile, 0.975)
)
alpha.table$z <- alpha.table$median / alpha.table$sd
alpha.table$p <- 2 * pnorm(
  -abs(alpha.table$z))
alpha.table$fdr <- p.adjust(
  alpha.table$p,
  method = "BH")
alpha.table$hr <- exp(alpha.table$median)
alpha.table$hr_low <- exp(alpha.table$cri_low)
alpha.table$hr_upp <- exp(alpha.table$cri_upp)
alpha.table$metabolite <- name_map[alpha.table$metabolite]
rownames(alpha.table) <- name_map[rownames(alpha.table)]

#> Parsing the table
table.doc <- alpha.table %>% dplyr::mutate(across(
  c(median, sd, cri_low, cri_upp,
    z, p, hr, hr_low, hr_upp, fdr),
  ~ round(.x, 2)
), `95% CrI` = paste0(hr_low, ",", hr_upp)) %>%
  dplyr::select(metabolite,hr, `95% CrI`,p, fdr) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Metabolite = metabolite, HR = hr, `Wald p-value` = p,FDR = fdr)

ft <- flextable(table.doc)
ft <- autofit(ft)
ft <- set_caption(
  ft,
  caption = "Association between longitudinal metabolites and survival hazard"
)
ft <- theme_booktabs(ft)
doc <- read_docx()
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft)
print(doc, target = "./tables/JM_survival_metabolite_table_hivneg.docx")
```
